data.title: Pflegegrad 3 granted for mother, €599/month care allowance
data.summary: The Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Bastian Musterquell that, based on the Medizinischer Dienst's assessment of 3 November 2026, his mother Edith Musterquell has been classified into Pflegegrad 3 effective 1 October 2026, granting a monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €599 for home care.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your mother's new care level (Pflegegrad 3) and the monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €599, as long as you and your sister provide the home care yourselves; if a professional care service is used instead, it bills the Pflegekasse directly. If you think the assessed care level is too low, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) — the app will show you the deadline for this. If you take no action, the decision becomes final and the allowance continues as described. No payment is required from you. Consider seeking advice from the Pflegekasse's advisory service if you want to challenge the level.
